situation (example wording): "Chicago robbery clearance by type in 2024", "Texas murder clearance by type in 2025", "murder clearance by type in the United States in 2024"
what the app does today: A table with only the clearance types that occurred (Chicago robbery 2024: two rows, cleared by arrest 704 and uncleared 8,170).
proposed behavior: Clearance by type always shows all seven rows, in this order, zeros included, for one agency, a state and the nation alike: Cleared by arrest; the five exceptional types (death of the offender, prosecution declined, in custody of another jurisdiction, victim refused to cooperate, juvenile with no custody); Uncleared. A type with no cases is a row of 0 (and 0 incidents). A clearance condition in the question keeps only the types it allows (cleared by exception: the five exceptional types). A period whose figures are not known gets no invented zeros.
exact default or choices offered: The seven-row table with the incidents beside each count.
why: Jeff 2026-11-21 (through the coordinator): always all seven rows, zeros included, for one agency, states and the nation.
